reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration for GitHub account binding, repository and code search, issue and pull request operations, comments, file access, and cloning repositories into selectable local workspaces through API tools and a browser sidebar panel.

summaries.zh: 通过 GitHub API 和浏览器侧边栏面板绑定账号、搜索和读取仓库内容、管理议题与拉取请求，并将仓库克隆为可选工作区。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to GitHub for account binding, repository and code search, issue and pull request management, content access, and cloning repositories into selectable workspaces.

capabilities: GitHub account binding with personal access tokens
Reading repository, code, issue, pull request, and file data
Creating GitHub issues, pull requests, and comments
Browser sidebar panel and workspace integration
